root_cause.text: The `free_qp` completion was initialized after the `ib_copy_to_udata` call in `irdma_create_qp`, so if that call fails and triggers `irdma_destroy_qp`, the cleanup path tries to wait on an uninitialized completion object.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "if ib_copy_to_udata fails, it will call irdma_destroy_qp to clean up which will attempt to wait on the free_qp completion, which is not initialized yet." The patch moves `init_completion(&iwqp->free_qp)` from after the `ib_copy_to_udata` block to before it, ensuring it is initialized before any failure path that uses it.

bic_trace_step.reason: In the provided `irdma_create_qp` function, the `init_completion(&iwqp->free_qp)` is called at the very end of the function (line ~1150) after the `ib_copy_to_udata` call (lines ~1135-1140). If `ib_copy_to_udata` fails, the code calls `irdma_destroy_qp` which in turn calls `wait_for_completion(&iwqp->free_qp)` on an uninitialized completion object, leading to a use-before-init vulnerability. This matches the root cause description exactly.
